body.statement: Can the joint-resolvent handle be turned into a finite, explicit deterministic system that outputs \(\mathfrak B(\xi)\), the norms \(\rho_j(b;\xi)\), the limiting objective values, their global-selection slacks \(G_b(\xi)\), and the branch derivatives needed for inference, such that, uniformly on compact subsets of \(\{0<\kappa<\kappa_{\mathrm{bal}}\}\) with \(d_{\mathrm{col}}(\xi)>0\), \(\mathbb P(\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n)\to1\), \(b^\star(\xi)\ne\bot\), and for every \(\varepsilon>0\), \(\mathbb P[\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\cap\{\max_{j\in\mathcal J}|\|\widehat\beta_{jn}\|_2-\rho_j(b^\star(\xi);\xi)|>\varepsilon\}]\to0\), while the same certified-event system gives the exact cells \(\mathcal C_+\), \(\mathcal C_0\), and \(\mathcal C_-\), every radius-saturation boundary, and the ordering relative to \(r_D\)? The \(E\)-method components of the system must use the unique original same-sample entropy weights on \(\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\); the total uniform fallback only defines finite-sample outputs off that event and is not part of the entropy-balance asymptotics. The answer must strictly extend Theorem 4 of FangRidderXie2026 from fixed policy dimension to \(p_n/n\to\kappa>0\), not replace the estimator by a cross-fitted or independent-weight surrogate.
body.justification: The system is the theorem-level kernel because proportional reuse of the design can reverse the classical HIR regret ranking.
body.gap: FangRidderXie2026 assumes fixed rule dimension, SurCandes2019 treats one convex logistic likelihood, and ThrampoulidisAbbasiHassibi2018 requires a convex Gaussian estimator; none handles two endogenous tilts followed by a nonconcave global policy optimizer.
body.consumer: The phase cells determine whether expanded-feature commitment-savings targeting should use known assignment probabilities, exact balancing, or oracle residualization.
